title: Chapter 04 — Supply and Demand
desc: Shifts vs movements, the five shifters of each curve, equilibrium, and shortages and surpluses — two live models and a chapter quiz.
h1: The model the rest of the course runs on
intro: Almost every remaining question is this diagram with a twist. The whole chapter reduces to two disciplines: knowing whether a change moves the curve or moves you along it, and working the new equilibrium out in a fixed order rather than guessing.
